snippet.title: Guardian Realms - Official Alpha Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the teaser trailer for the Trading Card Game, Guardian Realms TCG, which is now available for free on itch.io.

Download it here: https://guardianrealms.itch.io/guardian-realms-tcg

🔔Reminder that Guardian Realms is an open and transparent development project. As such, you will see work-in-progress AI placeholder art. Leave us your thoughts on our progress in the video comments!

💬 Let us know your favorite cards in the comments below!

Follow us on
👉     https://www.twitch.tv/guardianrealmstcg
👉     https://www.instagram.com/guardianrealmstcg
👉     https://x.com/GR_TCG

🗣 Join the discussion by connecting to our official discord   https://discord.gg/ayKgGXsUph
